data.name: Furie
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'Furia', which means fury, rage, or passionate one. In ancient Roman religion, Furia was the goddess of vengeance and avenging spirits. In Christianity, this name represents the fiery passion and intensity of the Holy Spirit.
